feesNote: All Bristol carers receive the Level 1 weekly allowance for each child; carers at Level 2 or 3 also receive a fixed weekly fee per child.
extras: Birthday and Christmas or religious festival payments for each child, from £170 to £276.71 each depending on age
Several school holiday payments through the year, set by the child's age
Start-up grant of up to £500 for new mainstream carers
Parent and child placements paid at £800 a week per family
Reimbursement if a carer loses the single person council tax discount because a young person aged 18 or over stays on
summary: Bristol pays every foster carer a Level 1 weekly allowance by the child's age, and adds a fixed weekly fee per child for carers at Level 2 or Level 3. The council's page does not state which year the rates apply to, so check the current figures with Bristol's fostering team before you apply.
